label: The 2019 Economist cover read as confirmation
description: He points to a 2019 magazine cover and identifies the mischief panda with folded arms as China as he was shown it, and a Pinocchio figure as Zelenskyy, noting the Ukraine war had not started when it was published. He states he is not giving the magazine credibility or mixing the prophetic with the world, and that the Lord told him to go and look. Recorded because reading published artwork as confirmation is a recurring method in the corpus.
aliases: they try to talk through magazines

label: China economy shakes and he turns his face toward Taiwan
description: A shaking of the Chinese economy with all the fingers pointing at the leader, after which he turns his face toward Taiwan. The sequence, crisis then diversion, is the checkable part.

label: Arab states ignore strikes on Iran but unite when Syria is struck
description: That the Arab states did not much mind Iran being hit, but when Syria is struck in the days ahead they will all come to its defence and rise up very upset, with ground invasions by forces in red headgear and Turkey beating war drums.
aliases: they will all come to the defense

label: A major earthquake in British Columbia
description: A shaking coming to British Columbia with a major earthquake there, given alongside whiskey barrels seen rolling down in Canada. British Columbia sits on the Cascadia margin, so the location is checkable.

label: Cuba rises up and helps Russia
description: Cuba rising into a friendship with Russia recalling the old Cuban missile crisis, with Cuba helping Russia in the days ahead, repeated as something he has warned of many times.
